app.name: OmniSense
global.download_start: Downloading local model (≈{{size}} first time, runs in background)
global.local_only: Everything runs locally; nothing is uploaded
global.nogpu: WebGPU not supported here; large-model features may be slow/unavailable, ad-block & privacy check still work
global.no_active_tab: No active tab to work with. Switch to a normal web page and try again.
global.long_input_truncated: The text is long, so only the beginning was used.
global.long_input_tail: The text is long, so only the most recent part was used.
global.context_exceeded: This text is longer than the local model can handle in one go. Try a shorter passage.
reader.no_article: This page has no readable article content (it may be a home or login page).
capsule.title: Time Capsule
capsule.subtitle: Search what you've seen locally. Your data never leaves the browser.
capsule.placeholder: Search your memory, e.g. “that article on attention mechanisms last month”
capsule.empty: No local memory yet. Use “Save this page” above to add the current page, or turn on auto-record in settings.
capsule.no_result: No matches. Try rephrasing, or use “View all” to see what is stored.
capsule.capture_pending: Saving this page to local memory (the embedder loads first, so this may take a moment)…
capsule.capture_too_short: This page's text is too short to save anything.
capsule.capture_unsupported: This page can't be saved — only http/https pages are supported.
capsule.capture_no_tab: No active tab found. Reload the page and try again.
capsule.capture_failed: Couldn't save this page. Please try again.
capsule.captured_first: OmniSense now saves the pages you read into your Time Capsule. Turn it off anytime in settings.
capsule.auto_off_hint: Auto-record is off. Use “Save this page” to add one manually.
capsule.confirm_clear: This cannot be undone. Clear anyway?
tone.title: Tone Rewriter
tone.placeholder: Paste or select text to rewrite…
tone.footer: All processing is local; your text never leaves the browser.
tone.slow: This device is slower at inference. Please wait.
roast.title: Roast Bot
roast.disclaimer: Just for fun. Don't take it seriously, and don't use it to hurt anyone.
roast.empty: Paste something for me to roast first.
privacy.title: Privacy Check
privacy.risk_low_desc: This page looks fairly clean; no obvious trackers found.
privacy.risk_medium_desc: Some third-party scripts or hidden fields were found.
privacy.risk_high_desc: Multiple trackers and suspicious data collection were found.
privacy.clean: No obvious trackers found. This page is pretty clean.
privacy.disclaimer: Based on a local rule set, for reference only, not a legal conclusion.
adblock.title: Ad Blocker
adblock.note: Rule-based filtering, no AI, no data collection.
adblock.false_positive: Something hidden by mistake? Allow ads on this page.
writing.title: Writing Assistant
writing.topic_placeholder: What do you want to write? e.g. an essay on remote work pros & cons
writing.instruction_placeholder: What do you want based on it? e.g. rewrite the core idea in plain language
writing.empty: Tell me what to write first.
writing.nogpu: Local large model unavailable. Writing is disabled (light features still work).
writing.long_hint: Original is long; key points were extracted first.
summary.title: Article Summary
summary.idle: Tap the button below to summarize this page.
summary.no_content: No readable article content on this page (home or login page).
summary.long_hint: Original is long; summarized in chunks and merged.
listen.title: Listen to Page
listen.voice_note: Uses your system voices: the voice matches the text's language, and long articles are read sentence by sentence without pauses.
listen.no_tts: Speech synthesis is not available on this system.
listen.long_hint: Long article; rewritten part by part and joined into one script.
listen.no_voice: No {{lang}} voice is installed, so playback was stopped. Install one in your system settings and try again.
settings.title: OmniSense Settings
settings.capsule.confirm: This cannot be undone. Clear anyway?
settings.adblock.rules_note: Curated built-in rules subset, updated with each release.
settings.about.local: Everything is processed locally. We can't see any of your content.
onboard.welcome_desc: All AI runs locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
onboard.capsule_desc: When enabled, OmniSense builds a semantically searchable local memory on your device. Your data never leaves the browser. You can turn it off anytime in settings — and even without it you can always save a page manually with “Save this page”.
onboard.model_desc: Some features need to download a local model (≈{{size}}) the first time. It works offline afterward.
onboard.done_desc: Right-click a page or open the side panel to start.
ctx.capture: OmniSense: Save page to Time Capsule

toast.permission_denied: Permission denied. Feature may be unavailable.
capsule.related_none: No closely related memories found yet
toast.tab_too_few: Need at least 2 tabs in current window to organize
toast.tab_no_clusters: Tabs have diverse topics, no grouping needed
ask.title: Ask Page
ask.placeholder: Ask anything about this page, e.g. What is the core argument?…
